scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer, formative only.
scoring.practice: Accurate explanation of learning versus familiarity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
scoring.transfer: Select an unfamiliar concept from a different field and test it again tomorrow without notes; record both recall and application.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require evidence at Level 2; no mastery from quiz score alone.
